biomarkers.name: Androgen receptor (AR)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Frequently positive and useful diagnostically; predictive for androgen deprivation therapy in recurrent/metastatic AR-positive disease (e.g., combined androgen blockade with bicalutamide plus an LHRH agonist)

biomarkers.name: HER2 (ERBB2)
biomarkers.clinical_use: HER2 amplification/overexpression supports HER2-directed therapy in advanced disease, including trastuzumab-based regimens; trastuzumab deruxtecan has shown activity in HER2-positive salivary gland carcinomas

biomarkers.name: TP53
biomarkers.clinical_use: Common alteration in salivary duct carcinoma; mainly of biologic/prognostic significance rather than standard actionable use

biomarkers.name: PIK3CA / PTEN
biomarkers.clinical_use: Alterations in the PI3K/AKT pathway are recurrent and may support enrollment in PI3K/AKT/mTOR-directed clinical trials

biomarkers.name: HRAS
biomarkers.clinical_use: Recurrent hotspot mutation in a subset of salivary duct carcinomas; may support consideration of pathway-directed clinical trials

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Resembles high-grade breast ductal carcinoma with cribriform, comedonecrosis, and papillary features
histomorphological_subtype.grading: High-grade by definition; often with adjacent intraductal carcinoma/ex-pleomorphic adenoma or DCIS-like architecture

tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Desmoplastic, similar to breast ductal carcinoma

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Excretory duct luminal cells of salivary glands
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Ectodermal oral epithelium-derived salivary gland ductal epithelium (including excretory/interlobular ducts)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Luminal/apocrine ductal differentiation with frequent AR expression; strong phenotypic parallel to apocrine breast carcinoma
